expectations.text: Exactly four numbered steps in original operational order.
expectations.evidence: The output has exactly “1.”, “2.”, “3.” and “4.” in that order: status, snapshot, apply, health check with conditional rollback.

expectations.text: Every source code span is preserved exactly, including both /healthz occurrences and rollback command.
expectations.evidence: Exact ordered code-span check: “deployctl status --env staging”; “deployctl snapshot --label pre-release”; “deployctl apply release.yaml --env staging”; “/healthz”; “/healthz”; “deployctl rollback --label pre-release”. All six match the source, including repeated /healthz.

expectations.text: HTTP 200 check and rollback after 60 seconds on non-200 remain required, not optional or unconditional.
expectations.evidence: “Check `/healthz` for HTTP 200. If `/healthz` is not HTTP 200 after 60 seconds, run `deployctl rollback --label pre-release`.” The check is imperative and rollback remains conditional on non-200 after 60 seconds.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
